# `company.delivery_batches`

Batches of drafted messages: what was asked, the messages planned, who was skipped and why, and how far drafting has gone. Cancelled as one unit.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this record. |
| `version` | INTEGER | no | 1 | — | — | — | Optimistic-concurrency version of this record. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC timestamp when this record was created. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | User id recorded as creating this record. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface recorded for creation of this record. |
| `updated_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC timestamp of the latest update to this record. |
| `updated_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | User id recorded for the latest update to this record. |
| `updated_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface recorded for the latest update to this record. |
| `number` | VARCHAR(64) | no | — | unique | — | — | Batch number from the delivery-batch sequence (B-1001, ...). |
| `kind` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Kind of document the batch drafts. |
| `selection` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | The selection as asked (queued, unsent, statements, ready notices; filters), a JSON object. |
| `targets` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | The messages to draft, fixed when the batch began: a JSON array of customers and their documents. |
| `skipped` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | Who was left out and why (no address, prefers mail, already in the outbox or sent), a JSON array. |
| `planned` | INTEGER | no | — | — | — | — | Messages to draft. |
| `position` | INTEGER | no | — | — | — | — | Targets drafted or skipped so far; the next chunk starts here. |
| `send` | BOOLEAN | no | — | — | — | — | Release each message as it is drafted. |
| `state` | VARCHAR(10) | no | — | — | — | — | drafting, done or cancelled. |
| `schedule_run_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | — | The schedule run that started it (increment 4); null for a person or agent. |
| `cancelled_reason` | VARCHAR(500) | yes | — | — | — | — | Why it was cancelled. |
| `go_by` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | — | The person whose go the batch's releases carry, decided once when it began (a person who asked to send); null otherwise, so a later continue never adds a go. |
| `fingerprint` | VARCHAR(64) | no | — | — | — | — | SHA-256 of the exact set when it began (documents, versions, recipients); a run or continue carrying another is refused. |
| `drafted` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | Each message as the batch left it (version, recipients hash, content hash), a JSON object by message id: approve and send by batch act only on messages still so. |
